title: COLLINS 8X
description: The default Minecraft textures are made using the resolution of 16 x 16. This pack retextures that to 8 x 8 resolution. This might sometimes increase you fps.
body:
![COLLINS 8X](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8dc8eeb2e288365f4b0666c727fdf73c47254959.png)

**COLLINS 8X** is a minimalist Minecraft texture pack designed around an ultra-low 8x8 resolution, cutting the standard 16x16 pixel size in half to deliver a clean, lightweight, and highly stylized visual experience. By reducing each texture to only 64 pixels total, the pack embraces simplicity while still preserving the identity and readability of every block, item, and environment in the game.

Despite its small resolution, COLLINS 8X focuses on strong color contrast and carefully placed shading to ensure that important details remain clear. Blocks like stone, wood, and ores are instantly recognizable, while natural elements such as grass, leaves, and water use smooth color transitions to avoid visual noise. The limited pixel count gives the world a soft, almost retro feel, reminiscent of early sandbox games and classic pixel art, yet it still feels modern and polished.

This pack is ideal for players who enjoy a clean aesthetic, want better performance on low-end systems, or simply prefer a more simplified visual style that reduces distraction during gameplay. The 8x8 resolution also makes the world feel more open and less cluttered, allowing builds, redstone contraptions, and landscapes to stand out through shape and color rather than fine detail.

COLLINS 8X proves that less can be more. By working within strict pixel limits, it creates a unique visual identity that is smooth, lightweight, and charming, offering a fresh way to experience Minecraft without sacrificing clarity or atmosphere.
